modern: It is a shame for the soul to be the first to give way in this life, when your body does not give way.
original: It is a shame for the soul to be first to give way in this life, when thy body does not give way.
notification: It is a shame for the soul to be the first to give way in this life, when your body does not give way.
notification_original: It is a shame for the soul to be first to give way in this life, when thy body does not give way.

explained.summary: It’s shameful for your mind and spirit to give up while your body is still going strong. If you can still walk, work and breathe, then giving in inwardly, losing your nerve or your standards, is the real failure.
